# dify_tools (Data Source)

Lists tools available in the workspace. `node_data` carries the server-provided workflow tool-node template as JSON — the exact `provider_id`, `provider_name`, and `plugin_unique_identifier` a tool node's DSL expects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dify_mcp_provider" "deepwiki" {
  name       = "deepwiki"
  server_url = "https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp"
}

# Filter by provider ID...
data "dify_tools" "deepwiki" {
  provider_name = dify_mcp_provider.deepwiki.id
}

# ...or search by keywords matched against name, label, and provider.
data "dify_tools" "search" {
  query = "search"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `provider_name` (String) Optional provider filter (e.g. `langgenius/tavily/tavily`).
- `query` (String) Optional words to match in the tool name or label, or the provider id or label.

### Read-Only

- `tools` (Attributes List) List of tools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))

<a id="nestedatt--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Tool label.
- `name` (String) Tool name.
- `node_data` (String) Workflow tool-node template for this tool, as JSON.
- `provider` (String) Provider id.
- `provider_type` (String) Provider type (`builtin`, `api`, `mcp`, `workflow`).
